target.native_mtp_source: The MTP weights shipped in this exact target checkpoint; no separately trained, converted or community MTP model

serving.release_policy: Official v0.28.0 release artifact, no PR checkout, nightly, fork or local engine patch. Source inclusion and recipe support do not replace the real three-route H100 compatibility gate.

quality.score_scope: Final answer content only; thinking is saved separately. Scorable wrong, empty and truncated responses retain the frozen denominator. Infrastructure or grader failures remain missing measurements, not silently counted model errors; a final full score requires all scheduled measurements to be resolved.
quality.code_grader: EvalPlus official sanitize and evaluate CLI

serving_checks.matched_subset: 32 task IDs per dataset selected by ascending SHA256 of UTF8 qwen38-plan-v1|20260906|dataset|task_id; ID tie-break; selection independent of old answers and new scores
serving_checks.request_seed: Integer from first 8 SHA256 hex digits of UTF8 base_seed|task_id, modulo 2147483647; identical across routes and concurrency for a task/repetition, not assumed to align random token draws
serving_checks.ordered_requests: Dataset names are exactly humaneval_plus and math_500. C/G preserve their listed task-ID order. S/F sort ascending SHA256 of UTF8 qwen38-order-v1|stage|base_seed|dataset|task_id with dataset/task_id tie-breaks; S sorts the mixed 64 tasks together, F sorts within each separate dataset group. Same ordered list across routes and concurrency. Freeze each actual ordered request list and hash before generation.
serving_checks.dispatch_policy: Closed-loop fixed client concurrency: dispatch the first min(concurrency, task_count) requests together, then dispatch the next item in the frozen list when a slot completes. No artificial think time or request-rate target. Record real dispatch/completion times; client backlog is in group wall time, not individual in-flight latency. Actual GPU batch shapes may differ and must not be described as controlled identical batches.

greedy_diagnostic.claim: Token/logit diagnostic, not final-answer quality scores or proof of distribution equivalence

throughput.output_tokens_per_second: Total authoritative completion tokens divided by the wall time of the same request group
throughput.engine_output_tokens_per_second: Delta of vllm:generation_tokens_total for the isolated model/engine over the same group's wall time, after pre/post snapshots are reconciled with final usage and no unrelated or warmup requests are present. This is serving throughput, not isolated GPU-kernel throughput.
throughput.engine_input_tokens_per_second: Group-local delta of vllm:prompt_tokens_total divided by group wall time, with computed/cached source breakdown recorded; never add rejected speculative drafts to committed output tokens
throughput.requests_per_second: Completed request count divided by group wall time
throughput.correct_answers_per_second: Count of responses with official grade correct AND finish_reason=stop divided by the entire same-group wall time, including time spent on wrong or truncated answers; code and math counts separately visible
throughput.raw_correct_count: All official correct grades retained as a separate accuracy numerator, including a length-stopped answer that happens to satisfy the grader; never substitute for normal-stop-and-correct goodput
throughput.warmup: One full concurrency wave of predetermined code/math warmups before each measured group; same profile and 512-token cap; two short waves for greedy diagnostic. Excluded from every score and measured clock, retained in evidence and billing.
throughput.thinking_token_boundary: Authoritative completion tokens include reasoning and final output. Report that total explicitly; separate reasoning/final token counts only if the actual API or verified raw token boundaries support them. Never use retokenized text as original server tokens.
throughput.measurement_clock: Monotonic start before dispatch of the first measured request to terminal receipt of the last; no grader, hash generation or post-run analysis inside the measured interval
throughput.resume_rule: Resumed groups remain valid per-task quality observations. A wall-time throughput result is valid only for an uninterrupted full group; never divide old cached tokens by resume wall time. Reruns require a separate supplemental performance group and cannot replace primary answers.

stream_measurement.clock: Client monotonic_ns; timestamp raw incoming data before JSON parsing, grading or synchronous artifact serialization; record wall UTC separately. The client runs beside the server through loopback, not across SSH or the public network.
stream_measurement.ttft_token: first non-empty generated token_ids event time minus dispatch; empty role, prompt-only, usage-only, comment and DONE events do not qualify
stream_measurement.ttft_visible: first non-empty delta.reasoning or delta.content time minus dispatch; not the time to the final answer
stream_measurement.time_to_first_final_answer: first non-empty delta.content time minus dispatch; null with an explicit missing-final status if none arrives
stream_measurement.tpot: For each request i: (last_token_time_i - first_token_time_i) / (completion_tokens_i - 1), only when that request has completion_tokens_i > 1 and validated token-ID coverage. Never use the group's sum of tokens in a per-request denominator. Otherwise null with reason, never fabricate zero. A single-chunk multi-token response can yield zero delivery TPOT and must be labeled SINGLE_CHUNK, not zero GPU compute time.
stream_measurement.e2e_latency: DONE time minus dispatch for a valid complete SSE response; separately retain last-token, finish and usage times
stream_measurement.chunk_boundary: stream_interval=1 does not guarantee one token per event under speculation. Record tokens per chunk; chunk gaps are delivery gaps, not individual-token GPU timings. Client TPOT is a delivery-average metric and server request TPOT is reported separately.
stream_measurement.integrity: Reassemble exactly one index-0 choice in event order, retaining reasoning and final content separately. Require DONE, finish_reason, final authoritative usage, stable request/model identity and original token-ID accounting. Validate actual special-token/usage semantics in C for all routes; unexplained mismatch or missing IDs blocks affected timing metrics and full dispatch, not a model quality verdict.
stream_measurement.recording: Retain raw SSE frames with receive timestamps and received partial data on failure. Timestamp before processing; persist with bounded buffering outside timing-critical parsing, include actual recorder overhead in end-to-end results and report client backpressure. No per-event compression, tokenization or grading in the receive loop.

statistics.percentile_method: linear interpolation on sorted valid per-request observations

stream_measurement.server_metrics_scope: Snapshot group-local counters and histogram sum/count/buckets after warmup drains and after the measured group drains. Keep process/model/engine labels and reconcile counts; reset, missing data or unrelated traffic invalidates that metric. Histogram means are sum/count; quantiles from buckets are approximate, never exact client P95. Missing metrics are an acceptance gap, not zero.

server_histogram_units.time_to_first_token_seconds: One observation per request that reaches first output; a later-aborted request may already have TTFT, so reconcile with first-output coverage, not blindly with final success count.
server_histogram_units.request_time_per_output_token_seconds: One observation per finished request. v0.28.0 records decode_time/(generated_tokens-1) for generated_tokens>1 and zero otherwise. Preserve this native mean and its single/zero-token count; do not compare its all-finished denominator to the client's >1-token subset as if populations matched.
server_histogram_units.e2e_queue_prefill_decode_seconds: Finished-request observations, reconciled to group-local request_success_total split by finished_reason; a finished request is not necessarily a correct answer or normal stop.
server_histogram_units.inter_token_latency_seconds: One sample per qualifying post-first generation-output update in the engine, which may contain multiple accepted speculative tokens. The count is not generated_tokens-requests and is not the number of SSE events. Preserve native unit and avoid per-token interpretation.

stream_measurement.server_return_token_path: Official v0.28.0 chat_completion_stream_generator protects token_ids even when the parsed delta is empty, provided return_token_ids=true and include_reasoning=true. Prompt IDs are separate. Verify actual EOS/special-token coverage against final usage on C; schema/source support is not runtime evidence.
stream_measurement.official_benchmark_boundary: vLLM v0.28.0 openai-chat benchmark starts TTFT on first choices event, including an empty role event; its latency includes final non-DONE usage. Preserve any native CLI results unchanged as supplemental references. Our token-ID and reasoning-aware metrics are explicitly author-defined; do not relabel corrected values as unmodified official bench output.
